notes: «رجل من أصحابنا يلقب بسكباج»: the man is named only by his laqab, read as narrator «سكباج»
«أبيه» after the first name is a bare relation, not completed
Ahmad relates «قال يوماً» of the Imam, who is named only in the scene («يقوم ببعض أمور الماضي»): not added as speaker; the narrated encounter is unsettled
